style.notes: Authored direction (no image reference). Candle-only light, gold Light / ink Gravity slip / wax seal, woodcut cards and Shadow ink stain all present at gameplay scale; checked title, play, scoring, Shadow, market, end screens. Gap: card art is procedural emblems, not illustrated; no audio.

playability.notes: Input-driven run (tests/driver.gd, pointer events only) from title through Patron, 3 Nights, 2 Markets to victory; Night 1 recorded with Godot Movie Maker. Bot plays strongly; human difficulty not playtested.

state_and_restart.notes: In-game checks pass: tap lay/return, reshuffle consumes exactly one, back->Continue restores identical state, restart resets; 65 rule tests incl. save roundtrip, bad save rejection, conservation.

build.notes: Debug APK exported headless with Godot 4.7.2 templates; minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, arm64-v8a + armeabi-v7a. Not installed on a device here.

assets.notes: No generated assets. All art procedural (art.gd, shaders). Fonts IM Fell + Playfair Display, OFL.
